cohort: 1070 women with twin pregnancies who underwent a trial of labor between 2003 and 2015
finding: In women with twin pregnancies attempting vaginal delivery, both nulliparity and nonvertex presentation of twin B were significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Nonvertex presentation of twin B was independently associated with combined vaginal-cesarean delivery, and neonates delivered via this method had a higher proportion of low Apgar scores compared to those delivered vaginally.
